Glad you got it working. I saved a note in the project's EngramDB memory: newer wkhtmltopdf versions need `--enable-local-file-access`, or the invoice PDF tests fail. It will come up for anyone who hits this later.

If your fix only lives on your machine (a local config or wrapper), you may want to commit it to the repo or CI too. Otherwise the tests will keep failing for anyone else on a newer wkhtmltopdf.
